description: Header file defining utilities, data structures, and function declarations for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) integration in PyTorch's MPS backend, including tensor handling, graph caching, and kernel management.

classes.name: MPSScalar
classes.description: Represents a scalar value in MPS with associated type and buffer.

classes.name: Placeholder
classes.description: Encapsulates placeholders for MPS graph tensors and associated data.

classes.name: MPSCachedKernel
classes.description: Caches an MPS kernel object for reuse.

classes.name: MPSCachedGraph
classes.description: Caches an MPS graph object for reuse.

methods.name: getMPSDataType
methods.description: Returns the MPS data type corresponding to a ScalarType.

methods.name: getMPSScalarType
methods.description: Returns the MPS scalar type for a given ScalarType.

methods.name: getMPSScalar
methods.description: Creates an MPSScalar from a Scalar and ScalarType.

methods.name: getMPSTypeString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of an MPS type.

methods.name: scalarToMetalTypeString
methods.description: Converts ScalarType to its Metal type string.

methods.name: getTensorAxes
methods.description: Returns tensor axes as NSArray of NSNumber.

methods.name: getMPSShapeString
methods.description: Returns a string describing an MPSShape.

methods.name: getTensorsStringKey
methods.description: Generates a string key for tensors.

methods.name: to_hex_key
methods.description: Converts a float to a hex string key.

methods.name: getArrayRefString
methods.description: Returns string representation of IntArrayRef.

methods.name: gatherViewTensor
methods.description: Returns a view tensor based on source tensor.

methods.name: scatterViewTensor
methods.description: Scatters source tensor into output tensor.

methods.name: castToIHFTypes
methods.description: Casts tensor to IHF types.

methods.name: castFromIHFTypes
methods.description: Casts tensor from IHF types.

methods.name: getStridedMPSNDArray
methods.description: Returns an MPSNDArray with strided data.

methods.name: getMPSNDArray
methods.description: Returns an MPSNDArray for a tensor.

methods.name: getTensorView
methods.description: Returns a tensor view with specified shape.

methods.name: getMPSShape
methods.description: Returns an MPSShape for a tensor.

methods.name: isTooLargeForMPSGraph
methods.description: Checks if tensor size exceeds MPS graph limits.

methods.name: exec_unary_kernel_with_params
methods.description: Executes a unary kernel with parameters on tensor iterator.

methods.name: exec_binary_kernel_with_params
methods.description: Executes a binary kernel with parameters on tensor iterator.
